result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where the delivery time and delivery fee text overlap in the 'Popular right now' section, plus minor cosmetic edge-clipping from horizontal carousels.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery time ('25–30 min') and the delivery fee label ('€0 delivery') are rendered on top of each other, producing garbled overlapping text like '25–3€0...elivery' before the '· Ramen' tag.
issues.suggestion: Separate the metadata into distinct inline elements with proper spacing (e.g., '25–30 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') and add a layout regression test to prevent text overlap.

issues.description: The right-most card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) and the category chips are clipped at the screen edge, and the bottom pizza card is cut off by the viewport.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for horizontally scrollable carousels, but ensure there is a clear affordance (peek width/fade) and consistent padding so clipping looks intentional rather than broken.
